sentences.text: In the present case, the matter has been amicably settled between both sides and all the pending cases have been compromised.

I.A. No. 5576 of 2024 is a joint compromise petition filed by both sides duly signed by opposite party No. 2 (Maseda Bibi) and her signature has been identified by Md. Nizamuddin, Advocate Clerk of the learned counsel on behalf of the opposite party No. 2.
5.

This Court is of the view that this is not a case of quashing of the complaint immediately after the case has been lodged, but where after trial the accused has been convicted and the said conviction has been affirmed in appeal.
Under the circumstance at this stage complaint cannot be quashed on Hasimuddin Sk.
